messages:
anna_finance: Short heads-up: we\'re sunsetting the legacy credit-topup and introducing a 15-minute capacity-smoothing window for billing to reduce invoice spikes. Opt-in pilot starts 2026-05-01. Please review.

billing-bot: Summary: credit_topup_sunset + capacity_smoothing_window. Pilot 2026-05-01; staged default later.

nate_support: What will customers see on invoices? Need to prep replies.

anna_finance: Invoices will show a new line "Smoothing adjustment" when applied. Remaining top-up balances become a one-time conversion voucher unless customer enrolls in the new small-business voucher program.

rachel_prod: Any runtime signals we should emit?

anna_finance: Add headers X-Redwood-CapWindow and X-Redwood-SmoothingPct. Meter events: cap_window_open, smoothing_applied. Console will have a "Preview conversion" tool.

devon_sre: I\'ll add smoke checks for headers and an alert if smoothing >20% for top customers.

nate_support: I\'ll draft KB + canned replies and post by 2026-04-20.

sam_ceo: Thanks team. Make the first 30 days after default opt-out to reduce churn risk.

anna_finance: Agreed. Action owners: support KB (nate_support by 2026-04-20), runtime headers/events (devon_sre by 2026-04-24), finance invoice template (anna_finance by 2026-05-01), sales outreach (sales ops by 2026-04-22).

billing-bot: Internal docs: https://redwood.example/internal/billing/capacity-smoothing. KB draft: https://redwood.example/drafts/billing/credit-sunset. End of thread.
